recommendations.name: Dominique Laporte
recommendations.headline: Customer Services Director at Alcatel-Lucent
recommendations.excerpt: He demonstrated strong expertise in Cloud technologies (particularly AWS) and software development (Python, Git), combined with a high level of autonomy, rigor, and a strong innovative mindset.
paragraphs: I had the pleasure of working with Reda for several years within the Digital Transformation Office at ALE International. He demonstrated strong expertise in Cloud technologies (particularly AWS) and software development (Python, Git), combined with a high level of autonomy, rigor, and a strong innovative mindset.

Reda was a key contributor to the deployment of our Data Factory, ensuring that security, governance, and maintainability were fully integrated. His ability to deliver on commitments, challenge existing solutions, and recommend the most appropriate technologies clearly sets him apart.
I highly recommend Reda for Big Data Engineering roles, as well as any Engineering position requiring strong technical leadership and a focus on innovation.

recommendations.name: Faissal Zita
recommendations.headline: Senior Data Engineer chez Capgemini
recommendations.excerpt: Reda a démontré des compétences exceptionnelles en utilisant Python ainsi que les technologies AWS pour gérer et analyser de grandes quantités de données dans des environnements cloud.
paragraphs: En tant que career manager de Reda Rafi chez Capgemini, j'ai eu l'opportunité de suivre de près son évolution et ses performances en tant qu'ingénieur en Big Data. Reda a démontré des compétences exceptionnelles en utilisant Python ainsi que les technologies AWS pour gérer et analyser de grandes quantités de données dans des environnements cloud.

Reda a une capacité remarquable à traiter des données complexes tout en assurant leur intégrité et leur sécurité. Il est également très engagé dans le partage de ses connaissances et la collaboration avec l'équipe, contribuant ainsi à un environnement de travail positif et productif.

Son dévouement à l'excellence et son désir constant d'améliorer ses compétences font de Reda un atout précieux pour notre équipe et pour l'entreprise. Je le recommande vivement pour toute opportunité future dans le domaine du Big Data

recommendations.excerpt: Beyond technical skills, Reda is a collaborative and effective communicator. I'm confident he would be a valuable asset to any team.
paragraphs: I've had the pleasure of collaborating with Reda on numerous candidate interviews at Capgemini.

He onsistently demonstrates a deep understanding of data engineering principles and a mastery of Python and AWS. His insightful questions and technical expertise have been instrumental in evaluating candidates.
Beyond technical skills, Reda is a collaborative and effective communicator. I'm confident he would be a valuable asset to any team.
I highly recommend Reda for any data engineering role, particularly those involving Python and AWS and I'm hopeful we'll have the opportunity to welcome him back to Capgemini someday.
